Definition: perhaps a provincial from a derivative of G4008 (Perœa, i.e. the region beyond the coast-line); Berœa, a place in Macedonia:--Berea.
BiblicalUsage: The name Berea appears in the New Testament. It turns up in Acts 17:10 and Acts 17:13.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Berea marks real ground in God's story, not a made-up setting.
